arms.confound: confound: with the literal phase_bounds (10, 25) inside Fair-N's 30 epochs, c36/c40 are seen only in epochs 26-30 (at <= 7 % of peak learning rate); baby_step applies its own hard-coded w_cons/w_phase (phase A 0/0 with the backbone frozen, B 0.5/0.3, C 0.3/0.3; lesson L2), so this arm reverts the curriculum together with those weights and cannot separate them. Decision 'Phase 6: E13 curriculum arm keeps the literal phase bounds' (2026-10-10, pending C1).

arms.change_reverted: auxiliary losses back on: w_cons 0.5, w_phase 0.3, w_circ_rel 0.2, w_div 1.0
epochs 30 -> 50 (the cosine horizon stretches with it)

sentences_prereg_9: In a one-seed ablation, reverting the training curriculum (flat back to the baby-step curriculum, phase bounds 10 and 25) changed c40 AUC by −2.35 pt against Fair-N (fixed-seed interval [−4.25, −0.52]; descriptive). Stopped at epoch 14 (divergence); evaluated from its last saved best.pt (best-validation checkpoint, epoch 13, EMA weights).
In a one-seed ablation, reverting the backbone learning rate (2e-4 back to 1e-5) changed c40 AUC by −4.07 pt against Fair-N (fixed-seed interval [−5.80, −2.45]; descriptive).
In a one-seed ablation, reverting the frequency-stream learning rate (2e-4 back to 1e-4) changed c40 AUC by 0.14 pt against Fair-N (fixed-seed interval [−1.00, 1.33]; descriptive).

In a one-seed ablation, reverting the removal of the auxiliary losses (w_cons 0.5, w_phase 0.3, w_circ_rel 0.2, w_div 1.0 back on) changed c40 AUC by 0.10 pt against Fair-N (fixed-seed interval [−0.94, 1.18]; descriptive).
In a one-seed ablation, reverting the training length (30 epochs back to 50) changed c40 AUC by 0.05 pt against Fair-N (fixed-seed interval [−1.02, 1.05]; descriptive).
item8_e13.f2_factual_note: Factual note (W3b-S1.md §6, finding F2, for the user at C2): as the curriculum run ran, epochs 1-10 trained on c0 and c23 only with the backbone frozen; epochs 11-14 trained on c0, c23, c28 and c32; the evaluated best.pt is from epoch 13. So the evaluated model never saw c36 or c40, and had only about 3 epochs with a trainable backbone. The registered phrase 'c36/c40 seen only in epochs 26-30' is literally true but incomplete for the run as it ran; only the user can amend the registered text. Also (W3b-S1 verifier side note): the curriculum run logs a non-zero λ although invariance_arm is none, and its divergence was an EMA validation collapse while raw validation stayed healthy (lesson W7-4).

health.label: health logs (prereg §7, §10): validation numbers from the train logs, never test numbers; reported, never used to drop a run
health.keys_used: EPOCH lines of the train log: λ (GRL schedule value at the end of the epoch), est_pm1 (compression-level estimator ±1-bin accuracy, epoch diagnostics), disc_bal_acc (discriminator balanced accuracy, train-stream monitor), val_auc_c23 / val_auc_c40 / sel (EMA validation), raw_val_auc_c23 / raw_val_auc_c40 / raw_sel (raw-weight validation, logged only when train.val_raw is on)
health.selected_epoch_rule: selected epoch = best.pt['epoch']; checked against the train log: that EPOCH line carries *BEST-AUC*, is the last *BEST-AUC* line, and its logged EMA sel equals best.pt['best_metric'] to the log's 5 decimals
health.reference: est_pm1 >= 0.7 (prereg §7, Phase 5.3 health gate; registered for E1; the flag is shown for every run as a fact)
health.lambda_note: λ is the GRL schedule value the trainer logs on every CAFRL run; the model builds the gradient-reversal discriminator only for GRL arms (src/models/cafrl.py, _GRL_ARMS). Fair-N and the five E13 runs have invariance_arm none (config.yaml), so their λ is logged but no adversarial loss acts; their disc_bal_acc is NaN by design (prereg §8 note).
health.sentence_prereg_9_e1_health: With the adversary, est_pm1 at the selected epoch was 0.9531 / 1.0000 / 1.0000 (Fair-N: 1.0000 / 1.0000 / 1.0000).
